name: Northwoods | BrrBerry
description: This strain inherits the sweet and fruity profile characteristic of Runtz strains, with notes of tropical fruits, citrus, and a hint of berry. The Superboof influence adds a subtle earthiness and herbal complexity. The flavor offers an initial burst of fruity sweetness, reminiscent of tropical candies, is complemented by undertones of earth and spice.
